_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: In the beginning, God spoke, and there was light.
The same God gathers us this morning.
We are small beneath the stars, and still you know our names.
What are we, that you keep us in mind?
Grace, love, and the company of the Spirit be with you.
And also with you.
Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, we have come.
Come, let us worship the God who is with us always. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Lift your eyes to the night sky — the moon, the stars, the work of God's fingers set in place.
How majestic is your name in all the earth.
The breath that swept over the deep waters at the beginning is the breath now moving in this room.
How majestic is your name in all the earth.
You crown us with honor we did not earn and call us your own, named and known.
How majestic is your name in all the earth.
So come up the mountain with the eleven, where the risen Christ promises: I am with you always.
How majestic is your name in all the earth. Glory to the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Lift your eyes to the stars God set in place.
How majestic is your name in all the earth.
So small beneath that sky, and still you know us.
How majestic is your name in all the earth.
Grace, love, and the Spirit's company meet us here.
How majestic is your name in all the earth.
Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, come, let us worship.
How majestic is your name in all the earth. Amen.
